# Halliday-Leonard General Contractors

> Custom home builder and general contractor in Ocean City, New Jersey.
> Halliday-Leonard has been building custom homes, developments, and joint
> ventures in the Ocean City, NJ area for more than 40 years. The site is a
> portfolio of completed work — it is not a real estate listings platform and
> does not publish prices or MLS data.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of the firm, services, and featured projects.
- [About](/about): Firm history and building standard.
- [Our Team](/team): The four partners.
- [Services](/services): Custom homes, developments, joint ventures, renovations.
- [Projects](/projects): Portfolio of completed building projects.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Client feedback.
- [Contact](/contact): Inquiry form, phone, email, and office address.
